verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·’ū ‘ā·la·yiḵ ū·ḇiq·hal ‘am·mîm hō·ṣen re·ḵeḇ wə·ḡal·gal yā·śî·mū ‘ā·la·yiḵ sā·ḇîḇ ṣin·nāh ū·mā·ḡên wə·qō·w·ḇa‘ wə·nā·ṯat·tî miš·pāṭ lip̄·nê·hem ū·šə·p̄ā·ṭūḵ bə·miš·pə·ṭê·hem
verses.literal: They will come against you with a host of peoples with weapons chariots and wagons They will array themselves against you on every side with buckler and shield and helmet I will delegate judgment to them and they will punish you according to their own standards

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י קִנְאָתִ֜י בָּ֗ךְ וְעָשׂ֤וּ אוֹתָךְ֙ בְּחֵמָ֔ה יָסִ֔ירוּ אַפֵּ֤ךְ וְאָזְנַ֙יִךְ֙ וְאַחֲרִיתֵ֖ךְ תִּפּ֑וֹל בַּחֶ֣רֶב הֵ֗מָּה יִקָּ֔חוּ בָּנַ֤יִךְ וּבְנוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ וְאַחֲרִיתֵ֖ךְ תֵּאָכֵ֥ל בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî qin·’ā·ṯî bāḵ wə·‘ā·śū ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bə·ḥê·māh yā·sî·rū ’ap·pêḵ wə·’ā·zə·na·yiḵ wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯêḵ tip·pō·wl ba·ḥe·reḇ hêm·māh yiq·qā·ḥū bā·na·yiḵ ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯa·yiḵ wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯêḵ tê·’ā·ḵêl bā·’êš
verses.literal: And I will set My jealous rage against you and they will deal with you in fury They will cut off your noses and ears and your survivors will fall by the sword They will seize your sons and daughters and your remnant will be consumed by fire

verses.original: וְהִפְשִׁיט֖וּךְ אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֑יִךְ וְלָקְח֖וּ תִפְאַרְתֵּֽךְ׃ כְּלֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: wə·hip̄·šî·ṭūḵ ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏā·yiḵ wə·lā·qə·ḥū ṯip̄·’ar·têḵ kə·lê
verses.literal: They will strip off - your clothes and take your fine jewelry

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֤י מִמֵּ֔ךְ וְאֶת־ זִמָּתֵךְ֙ זְנוּתֵ֖ךְ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא־ תִשְׂאִ֤י עֵינַ֙יִךְ֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם תִזְכְּרִי־ וּמִצְרַ֖יִם לֹ֥א עֽוֹד׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·bat·tî mim·mêḵ wə·’eṯ- zim·mā·ṯêḵ zə·nū·ṯêḵ mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·lō- ṯiś·’î ‘ê·na·yiḵ ’ă·lê·hem ṯiz·kə·rî- ū·miṣ·ra·yim lō ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: So I will put an end to - your indecency and prostitution which began in the land of Egypt and you will not lift your eyes to them or remember Egypt . . . anymore

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ הִנְנִי֙ נֹֽתְנָ֔ךְ בְּיַ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֑את בְּיַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־ נַפְשֵׁ֖ךְ מֵהֶֽם׃ נָקְעָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nî nō·ṯə·nāḵ bə·yaḏ ’ă·šer śā·nêṯ bə·yaḏ ’ă·šer- nap̄·šêḵ mê·hem nā·qə·‘āh
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says Surely I will deliver you into the hands - of those you hate . . . from whom you turned away . . . in disgust

verses.original: וְעָשׂ֨וּ אוֹתָ֜ךְ בְּשִׂנְאָ֗ה וְלָקְחוּ֙ כָּל־ יְגִיעֵ֔ךְ וַעֲזָב֖וּךְ עֵירֹ֣ם וְעֶרְיָ֑ה עֶרְוַ֣ת זְנוּנַ֔יִךְ וְנִגְלָה֙ וְזִמָּתֵ֖ךְ וְתַזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śū ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bə·śin·’āh wə·lā·qə·ḥū kāl- yə·ḡî·‘êḵ wa·‘ă·zā·ḇūḵ ‘ê·rōm wə·‘er·yāh ‘er·waṯ zə·nū·na·yiḵ wə·niḡ·lāh wə·zim·mā·ṯêḵ wə·ṯaz·nū·ṯā·yiḵ
verses.literal: They will treat . . . you with hatred take all for which you have worked and leave you naked and bare so that the shame of your prostitution will be exposed Your indecency and promiscuity

verses.original: עָשֹׂ֥ה אֵ֖לֶּה לָ֑ךְ בִּזְנוֹתֵךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ נִטְמֵ֖את בְּגִלּוּלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·śōh ’êl·leh lāḵ biz·nō·w·ṯêḵ ’a·ḥă·rê ḡō·w·yim ‘al ’ă·šer- niṭ·mêṯ bə·ḡil·lū·lê·hem
verses.literal: have brought these things upon you because you have prostituted yourself with the nations . . . - and defiled yourself with their idols

verses.original: הָלָ֑כְתְּ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ אֲחוֹתֵ֖ךְ וְנָתַתִּ֥י כוֹסָ֖הּ בְּיָדֵֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·lā·ḵət bə·ḏe·reḵ ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ wə·nā·ṯat·tî ḵō·w·sāh bə·yā·ḏêḵ
verses.literal: Because you have followed the path of your sister I will put her cup into your hand

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ תִּשְׁתִּ֔י אֲחוֹתֵךְ֙ כּ֤וֹס הָעֲמֻקָּ֖ה וְהָרְחָבָ֑ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לִצְחֹ֛ק וּלְלַ֖עַג לְהָכִֽיל׃ מִרְבָּ֥ה
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar tiš·tî ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ kō·ws hā·‘ă·muq·qāh wə·hā·rə·ḥā·ḇāh tih·yeh liṣ·ḥōq ū·lə·la·‘aḡ lə·hā·ḵîl mir·bāh
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says You will drink your sister’s cup a cup deep and wide It will bring scorn and derision for it holds so much

verses.original: תִּמָּלֵ֑אִי שִׁכָּר֥וֹן וְיָג֖וֹן כּ֚וֹס שַׁמָּ֣ה וּשְׁמָמָ֔ה כּ֖וֹס אֲחוֹתֵ֥ךְ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: tim·mā·lê·’î šik·kā·rō·wn wə·yā·ḡō·wn kō·ws šam·māh ū·šə·mā·māh kō·ws ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: You will be filled with drunkenness and grief with a cup of devastation and desolation the cup of your sister Samaria

verses.original: וְשָׁתִ֨ית אוֹתָ֜הּ וּמָצִ֗ית וְאֶת־ תְּגָרֵ֖מִי חֲרָשֶׂ֛יהָ תְּנַתֵּ֑קִי וְשָׁדַ֣יִךְ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ṯîṯ ’ō·w·ṯāh ū·mā·ṣîṯ wə·’eṯ- tə·ḡā·rê·mî ḥă·rā·śe·hā tə·nat·tê·qî wə·šā·ḏa·yiḵ kî ’ă·nî ḏib·bar·tî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: You will drink it - and drain it - you will dash it to pieces and tear your breasts For I have spoken declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ יַ֚עַן שָׁכַ֣חַתְּ אוֹתִ֔י וַתַּשְׁלִ֥יכִי אוֹתִ֖י אַחֲרֵ֣י גַוֵּ֑ךְ וְגַם־ אַ֛תְּ שְׂאִ֥י זִמָּתֵ֖ךְ וְאֶת־ תַּזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an šā·ḵa·ḥat ’ō·w·ṯî wat·taš·lî·ḵî ’ō·w·ṯî ’a·ḥă·rê ḡaw·wêḵ wə·ḡam- ’at śə·’î zim·mā·ṯêḵ wə·’eṯ- taz·nū·ṯā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Because you have forgotten Me and have cast Me behind your back . . . you must bear the consequences [of] your indecency and prostitution

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הֲתִשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶֽת־ אָהֳלָ֖ה וְאֶת־ אָהֳלִיבָ֑ה וְהַגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֔ן אֵ֖ת תוֹעֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ben- ’ā·ḏām hă·ṯiš·pō·wṭ ’eṯ- ’ā·ho·lāh wə·’eṯ- ’ā·ho·lî·ḇāh wə·hag·gêḏ lā·hen ’êṯ ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hen
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me Son of man will you pass judgment - against Oholah - and Oholibah Then declare to them - their abominations

verses.original: כִּ֣י נִאֵ֗פוּ וְדָם֙ בִּֽידֵיהֶ֔ן וְאֶת־ נִאֵ֑פוּ גִּלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֖ן וְגַ֤ם אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָֽלְדוּ־ לִ֔י הֶעֱבִ֥ירוּ לְאָכְלָֽה׃ לָהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: kî ni·’ê·p̄ū wə·ḏām bî·ḏê·hen wə·’eṯ- ni·’ê·p̄ū gil·lū·lê·hen wə·ḡam ’eṯ- bə·nê·hen ’ă·šer yā·lə·ḏū- lî he·‘ĕ·ḇî·rū lə·’āḵ·lāh lā·hem
verses.literal: For they have committed adultery and blood is on their hands . . . They have committed adultery with their idols They have even - {sacrificed} their children whom they bore to Me in the fire as food for their idols

verses.original: ע֥וֹד עָ֣שׂוּ זֹ֖את לִ֑י הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם וְאֶת־ טִמְּא֤וּ אֶת־ מִקְדָּשִׁי֙ חִלֵּֽלוּ׃ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ ‘ā·śū zōṯ lî ha·hū bay·yō·wm wə·’eṯ- ṭim·mə·’ū ’eṯ- miq·dā·šî ḥil·lê·lū šab·bə·ṯō·w·ṯay
verses.literal: They have also done this to Me On that very same day - they defiled - My sanctuary and profaned My Sabbaths

verses.original: הַה֖וּא בַּיּ֥וֹם וּֽבְשַׁחֲטָ֤ם אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶם֙ לְגִלּ֣וּלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶל־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֛י לְחַלְּל֑וֹ וְהִנֵּה־ עָשׂ֖וּ כֹ֥ה בְּת֥וֹךְ בֵּיתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm ū·ḇə·ša·ḥă·ṭām ’eṯ- bə·nê·hem lə·ḡil·lū·lê·hem way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- miq·dā·šî lə·ḥal·lə·lōw wə·hin·nêh- ‘ā·śū ḵōh bə·ṯō·wḵ bê·ṯî
verses.literal: On the very day they slaughtered - their children for their idols they entered . . . My sanctuary to profane it Yes they did this inside My house

verses.original: וְאַ֗ף כִּ֤י תִשְׁלַ֙חְנָה֙ מַלְאָ֜ךְ שָׁל֤וּחַ אֲלֵיהֶם֙ לַֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים בָּאִ֖ים מִמֶּרְחָ֑ק אֲשֶׁ֨ר וְהִנֵּה־ בָ֔אוּ רָחַ֛צְתְּ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּחַ֥לְתְּ עֵינַ֖יִךְ וְעָ֥דִית עֶֽדִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ap̄ kî ṯiš·laḥ·nāh mal·’āḵ šā·lū·aḥ ’ă·lê·hem la·’ă·nā·šîm bā·’îm mim·mer·ḥāq ’ă·šer wə·hin·nêh- ḇā·’ū rā·ḥaṣt la·’ă·šer kā·ḥalt ‘ê·na·yiḵ wə·‘ā·ḏîṯ ‘e·ḏî
verses.literal: Furthermore . . . you sisters sent messengers - - for men who came from afar - and behold when they arrived you bathed for them painted your eyes and adorned yourself with jewelry

verses.original: וְיָשַׁבְתְּ֙ עַל־ מִטָּ֣ה כְבוּדָּ֔ה וְשֻׁלְחָ֥ן עָר֖וּךְ לְפָנֶ֑יהָ עָלֶֽיהָ׃ שַׂ֥מְתְּ וּקְטָרְתִּ֥י וְשַׁמְנִ֖י
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šaḇt ‘al- miṭ·ṭāh ḵə·ḇū·dāh wə·šul·ḥān ‘ā·rūḵ lə·p̄ā·ne·hā ‘ā·le·hā śamt ū·qə·ṭā·rə·tî wə·šam·nî
verses.literal: You sat on a couch of luxury with a table spread before it on which you had set My incense and My oil

verses.original: בָהּ֒ וְק֣וֹל שָׁלֵ֣ו הָמוֹן֮ סוֹבָאִים מוּבָאִ֥ים מִמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְאֶל־ אֲנָשִׁים֙ מֵרֹ֣ב אָדָ֔ם וַֽיִּתְּנ֤וּ צְמִידִים֙ אֶל־ יְדֵיהֶ֔ן תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת וַעֲטֶ֥רֶת עַל־ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ḇāh wə·qō·wl šā·lêw hā·mō·wn sō·ḇå̄·ʾīm mū·ḇā·’îm mim·miḏ·bār wə·’el- ’ă·nā·šîm mê·rōḇ ’ā·ḏām way·yit·tə·nū ṣə·mî·ḏîm ’el- yə·ḏê·hen tip̄·’e·reṯ wa·‘ă·ṭe·reṯ ‘al- rā·šê·hen
verses.literal: accompanied by the sound of a carefree crowd Drunkards were brought in from the desert along with men from the rabble . . . who put bracelets on your wrists and beautiful crowns on your head

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר לַבָּלָ֖ה נִֽאוּפִ֑ים עַתָּ יִזְנֻה תַזְנוּתֶ֖הָ וָהִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar lab·bā·lāh ni·’ū·p̄îm ʿa·tå̄ yiz·nuh ṯaz·nū·ṯe·hā wā·hî
verses.literal: Then I said of [her] [who] [had] [grown] old in adulteries Now let them use her as a prostitute . . . for that is all she is

verses.original: וַיָּב֣וֹא אֵלֶ֔יהָ אֶל־ כְּב֖וֹא אִשָּׁ֣ה זוֹנָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן בָּ֗אוּ אֶֽל־ אָֽהֳלָה֙ וְאֶל־ אָ֣הֳלִיבָ֔ה הַזִּמָּֽה׃ אִשֹּׁ֖ת
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·w ’ê·le·hā ’el- kə·ḇō·w ’iš·šāh zō·w·nāh kên bā·’ū ’el- ’ā·ho·lāh wə·’el- ’ā·ho·lî·ḇāh haz·zim·māh ’iš·šōṯ
verses.literal: And they slept with her as with a prostitute . . . they slept with . . . Oholah . . . and Oholibah those lewd women

verses.original: צַדִּיקִ֗ם הֵ֚מָּה וַאֲנָשִׁ֣ים יִשְׁפְּט֣וּ אֽוֹתְהֶ֔ם וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט נֹֽאֲפ֔וֹת שֹׁפְכ֣וֹת דָּ֑ם מִשְׁפַּט֙ כִּ֤י הֵ֔נָּה נֹֽאֲפֹת֙ וְדָ֖ם בִּֽידֵיהֶֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dî·qim hêm·māh wa·’ă·nā·šîm yiš·pə·ṭū ’ō·wṯ·hem ū·miš·paṭ nō·’ă·p̄ō·wṯ šō·p̄ə·ḵō·wṯ dām miš·paṭ kî hên·nāh nō·’ă·p̄ōṯ wə·ḏām bî·ḏê·hen
verses.literal: But righteous . . . men will sentence them to the punishment of those who commit adultery and bloodshed . . . . . . because they are adulteresses with blood on their hands

verses.original: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הַעֲלֵ֤ה אָמַ֖ר קָהָ֔ל עֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְנָתֹ֥ן אֶתְהֶ֖ן לְזַעֲוָ֥ה וְלָבַֽז׃
verses.transliteration: kî kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ha·‘ă·lêh ’ā·mar qā·hāl ‘ă·lê·hem wə·nā·ṯōn ’eṯ·hen lə·za·‘ă·wāh wə·lā·ḇaz
verses.literal: - This is what the Lord GOD . . . says Bring a mob against them and consign them to terror and plunder

verses.original: קָהָ֔ל וְרָגְמ֨וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֥ן אֶ֙בֶן֙ וּבָרֵ֥א אוֹתְהֶ֖ן בְּחַרְבוֹתָ֑ם יַהֲרֹ֔גוּ בְּנֵיהֶ֤ם וּבְנֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ יִשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃ וּבָתֵּיהֶ֖ן בָּאֵ֥שׁ
verses.transliteration: qā·hāl wə·rā·ḡə·mū ‘ă·lê·hen ’e·ḇen ū·ḇā·rê ’ō·wṯ·hen bə·ḥar·ḇō·w·ṯām ya·hă·rō·ḡū bə·nê·hem ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯê·hem yiś·rō·p̄ū ū·ḇāt·tê·hen bā·’êš
verses.literal: The mob will stone them and cut them down - with their swords They will kill their sons and daughters and burn down their houses -

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י זִמָּ֖ה מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כָּל־ הַנָּשִׁ֔ים וְנִֽוַּסְּרוּ֙ וְלֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ינָה כְּזִמַּתְכֶֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·bat·tî zim·māh min- hā·’ā·reṣ kāl- han·nā·šîm wə·niw·was·sə·rū wə·lō ṯa·‘ă·śe·nāh kə·zim·maṯ·ḵe·nāh
verses.literal: So I will put an end to indecency in the land and all the women will be admonished not to imitate your behavior

verses.original: וְנָתְנ֤וּ זִמַּתְכֶ֙נָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ן תִּשֶּׂ֑אינָה וַחֲטָאֵ֥י גִלּוּלֵיכֶ֖ן וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯə·nū zim·maṯ·ḵe·nāh ‘ă·lê·ḵen tiś·śe·nāh wa·ḥă·ṭā·’ê ḡil·lū·lê·ḵen wî·ḏa‘·tem kî ’ă·nî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: They will repay you for your indecency . . . and you will bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD
